# Quick2 CPU frontier engine

Independent GPL-3.0-or-later implementation developed in the local frontier-routing
experiment. No FairlySoon source or executable is included. Quick2 shares the
existing motion kernel and authoritative chronological validator; its bounded
frontier is an approximate search and does not establish optimality.

The host keeps a Quick2 candidate outside subsequent engines. Standard always
starts independently with its original allowance; Quick2 is never its incumbent.
Comfort searches use the same version of the shared severity model as Standard
and the existing Fastest/Comfort comparison. The full FairlySoon comfort policy
remains a separately documented evaluation, not an unqualified default change.
